title: Rewrite development setup scripts for TypeScript-only workflow

subtasks.content: Rewrite `tools/setup-dev-env.sh`: remove Python 3.9+ check, pip install, and pytest references; add Node.js 18+ and npm version checks with `set -e` exit-on-failure
In `tools/setup-dev-env.sh`: replace `pip install -e ".[dev]"` with `npm ci` in `vscode-extension/`; keep pre-commit hook installation and `pre-commit run --all-files`
In `tools/setup-dev-env.sh`: update next-steps messaging to reference `task test:unit`, `task lint`, `task build`, and F5 launch in VS Code; preserve emoji status indicators
Rewrite `tools/Check-Prerequisites.ps1`: remove `Test-PythonPackage` and `Test-PipPackage` helper functions; remove the `-SkipPythonPackages` parameter
In `tools/Check-Prerequisites.ps1`: remove the entire Python section (Python version check, pip packages: pytest, black, flake8, mypy, isort, pygls, pyyaml)

In `tools/Check-Prerequisites.ps1`: ensure checks cover exactly Git, GitHub CLI (with auth status), Node.js 18+, npm, VS Code, and `vscode-extension/node_modules`; retain `Write-Check`, `Get-CommandVersion`, `Test-MinVersion`, `-Detailed` parameter, box-drawing banners, and summary/exit-code behavior
Rewrite `tools/Install-Prerequisites.ps1`: remove the Python prerequisite entry from the `$Prerequisites` array and the `pip install pychivalry` next-step message

In `tools/Install-Prerequisites.ps1`: verify the prerequisites list contains only Node.js, Git, GitHub CLI, and VS Code entries; retain `Write-Status`, `Show-Banner`, helpers, `-Auto` parameter, and winget install flow
Run `grep -riE 'python|pip |pytest|pygls|pyyaml|black|flake8|mypy|isort|setup\.py|pychivalry' tools/` to verify zero Python-related references remain in any `tools/` script
Validate `tools/Check-Prerequisites.ps1` and `tools/Install-Prerequisites.ps1` syntax with PowerShell parsing or manual review
Review next-steps messaging in all three scripts for consistency: references to `npm ci`, `task build`, `task test:unit`, `task lint`, and F5 in VS Code
